rows.dau_shri_vasudev_chandrakar_kamdhenu_vis: Consolidated emoluments of Rs. 42,000 per month
Master's degree in Biotechnology with sound knowledge and practical experience in handling instruments used in molecular biology research.
Minimum will be 21 years and maximum 45 years (as on 31 December 2025)
The Director, Animal Biotechnology Centre, DSVCKV, Durg

content_sections.heading: DSVCKV Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. ABTC/DSVCKV/2026/370 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DSVCKV notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's degree in Biotechnology; Sound knowledge and practical experience in handling instruments used in molecular biology research Experience: Practical experience in handling instruments used in molecular biology research Age limit: Minimum will be 21 years and maximum 45 years (as on 31 December 2025) Other conditions: Sound knowledge and practical experience in handling instruments used in molecular biology research Selected candidate should meet the required eligibility on or before the last date of application

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary and contractual engagement for a short-term period Maximum tenure 01 year, may be extended further up to 01 year based on satisfactory performance Two days casual leave per month, maximum 10 days paid casual leave in a calendar year Competent Authority may terminate the appointment on one-month prior notice without assigning any reason No claim to regular appointment or permanent employment at the University

content_sections.heading: How Will DSVCKV Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening and scoring of applications as per the prescribed scorecard Merit list of eligible candidates uploaded on the University website Interview of a maximum of 10 shortlisted candidates Higher Secondary: 10 marks, based on percentage (70% = 7 marks) Gold medal 2 marks per medal, merit scholarship 1 mark each: max 06 marks Additional qualification (technical/computer diploma) 2 marks each, max 04; working experience 3 marks per year, max 15 NCC/NSS/sports/cultural certificates: max 05 marks Interview: 20 marks; total 100 marks; maximum 10 candidates shortlisted for interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format (Annexure-I) Self-attested scanned copies of relevant original documents Experience certificates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DSVCKV Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format given as Annexure-I of the notice. Attach self-attested scanned copies of relevant original documents and experience certificates. Send by post or submit in person to the Director, Animal Biotechnology Centre, DSVCKV, Durg. Submit on or before 16 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Merit list of eligible candidates will be uploaded on the University website; no individual correspondence No TA and DA will be paid for the interview Experience as YP-II gives no entitlement or preference for any regular post at the University Besides laboratory work, the YP-II may be assigned other official duties as required by the University

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DSVCKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DSVCKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Young Professional-II (YP-II).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DSVCKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of this notice (pages 3-4)) and send it to The Director, Animal Biotechnology Centre, DSVCKV, Durg, by by post or in person, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum will be 21 years and maximum 45 years (as on 31 December 2025).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated emoluments of Rs. 42,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree in Biotechnology with sound knowledge and practical experience in handling instruments used in molecular biology research.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Sound knowledge and practical experience in handling instruments used in molecular biology research. Selected candidate should meet the required eligibility on or before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening and scoring of applications as per the prescribed scorecard. Merit list of eligible candidates uploaded on the University website. Interview of a maximum of 10 shortlisted candidates. Higher Secondary: 10 marks, based on percentage (70% = 7 marks).

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary and contractual engagement for a short-term period. Maximum tenure 01 year, may be extended further up to 01 year based on satisfactory performance. Two days casual leave per month, maximum 10 days paid casual leave in a calendar year.
